messages:
maria_cs: Quick weekly health check — spotted a hosted spend spike for Helix (last 24h). Can we triage?
Summary: +320% YoY-ish day-over-day, tokens ~4.2M yesterday vs ~1.0M baseline, latency and error rate look normal. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/billing/helix (redacted).

billing-bot: ALERT: helix-corp exceeded commit threshold (120%) for hosted API on 2610001200. Triggered anomaly flag. Report: https://redwood.app/alerts/ALRT-8231

jason_se: I'll take a look. @linda_fin do we have commit details for Helix? Could be a dev/test key hitting prod.

arjun_data: quick log grep shows a surge of embedding calls from key `h-helix-staging-key` around 08:15 UTC. Sample snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T08:15:23Z] INFO embeddings.create account=helix-corp key=h-helix-staging-key tokens=1_200_000 model=text-embed-1
[2026-03-20T08:16:01Z] INFO embeddings.create account=helix-corp key=h-helix-staging-key tokens=900_000 model=text-embed-1
```
Looks like non-prod harness sending high-volume embedding batches.

linda_fin: Confirmed commit: helix-corp committed 500k tokens/day for hosted. Billing shows ~4.2M used yesterday. I'm pausing suspected non-prod keys for Helix now (revoking `h-helix-staging-key`). ETA ~7m.

maria_cs: Action items: jason to confirm root cause + code path, arjun to verify logs and suggest rate limit, linda to handle key pause and billing adjustment. I'll notify the Helix CSM and add to weekly deck.

jason_se: Root cause repro'd — QA harness env var was flipped, sends batches to prod endpoint. Quick mitigation: add environment header check in our routing and recommend client-side gating. Proposed quick patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/ingress/pull/442 (adds X-Env guard).

ops-bot: revoke_key(h-helix-staging-key) succeeded by linda_fin at 2610001640. Cost-surge alert SILENCED for helix-corp.

linda_fin: Opening billing ticket BT-4521 to propose one-time credit for the overflow day. Suggested credit: 20% of overage. CC: @maria_cs @jason_se.

maria_cs: For the weekly health note: spend vs commit — commit 500k/day, observed 4.2M yesterday, anomaly flagged and mitigated (test harness -> prod). Suggested follow-ups: credit request + guardrail rollout. Renewal risk: low if we handle credit & enable guardrails; noting as "monitoring" in renewal tracker.

neal_se: Recommend a 30-min enablement with Helix devops to cover non-prod gating + include example config snippet for clients. I can schedule and send calendar invite later today.

maria_cs: Great — please add the guide link to the Helix onboarding repo and I'll follow up in the account health doc. Thanks all :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
